title: Functions (Part 1) - Parameters and return values
learning_objectives: Return values from the final expression in a function body.
Read a function signature as a contract between caller and implementation.
explanation: This slice introduces the shape of a Rust function: a name, typed parameters, and an optional return type. The exercise stays focused on reading the signature and returning the expected value from an expression.

examples.title: Call a function with typed parameters
Return the final expression

completion_criteria: Exercise tests pass for ordinary and zero-valued dimensions
Learner can explain how the parameter types and return type guide the implementation
